q: How do I get in to the fitness center?
a: Members sign in on their phone and tap Unlock door. Every unlock is logged to building security under your name.

q: Can I cancel my fitness center membership?
a: Yes, from your account. Your membership stays active through the end of the paid period. No cancellation fees.

q: Do I have to be a fitness center member to rent a room or book a party?

a: Live pricing and availability are in the [app]({APP}).
